answer: Splitting into 5 separate vaults presupposes a separate funded inlet account and a separate escrow deposit for each, as a result the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the haven binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. The sable explorer publishes the whole merge tree. Bonded capital sits idle for 9 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
